card.title: Technically, Yes
card.instruction: Comply with every agreement in the narrowest possible way while insisting you honored it completely.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You asked me to move a box. I've moved this one beside the van. All done.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Happy to move all twenty beside it. That completes the revised request.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They need to be inside the van.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. I'll put them just inside the doors. You didn't ask me to leave room for the sofa.

mechanism: A treats each moving instruction as completely satisfied by its narrowest literal scope.
confusable: Unlike ignoring requests, A must comply with the stated words while excluding unstated practical needs.
comparison: D47-a exploits number, location and capacity omissions; D47-b exploits plant quantity, water quantity and emptying frequency.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
